title: P15.10-C R2: fenced authority closure — claimed-version commit guard, guarded review commit, absolute lease lifetime at the canonical validation boundary
description: R2 remediation on PR #87 (BASE 0e27bc6ee236d82633d4aee321ba9cd264adc0c3), closing residual F1 audit findings — all three CONFIRMED by pre-patch repro tests. F1.1: driver authorityGate checked only lease state/fence/expiry + evaluate().effective — a PAUSE->RESUME mid-await produced an effective policy at version V+2 that was NOT the claimed authorization. Fix: new scheduler.assertLeaseAuthority(handle) — a narrow read-only assertion that re-proves state, fence, worker/boot identity, token digest, claimed generation, checkpoint, expiry, absolute lifetime, and the captured policy_version/terms_digest/owner/objective_version pins through the single existing currentLease path (no parallel validator); authorityGate calls it first and wraps any refusal as DRIVER_AUTHORITY_LOST. F1.2: commitReview ran its own store.immediate writing the review receipt, optional strategy revision and anchors with no guard — the guard now fires FIRST inside that transaction (forwarded from runReview input), so a revoke landing between the CEO decision commit and the review commit rolls back every review side effect; deterministic checkpoints (zero model calls) get the same protection; manual callers unchanged. F1.3: renew() stamped expires_at=now+60s past the absolute lifetime and currentLease never checked lifetime — post-deadline settle/assert still passed. Fix: absolute lifetime (started_at+max_lifetime_ms) enforced inside currentLease — every renew/settle/assert path; renewed expires_at additionally CLAMPED at the deadline so a lease can never outlive its bound. TTL stays 60s, heartbeat stays 20s, claim-bound semantics and P15.10-B defaults unchanged. R2-F1a..j tests prove: pause->resume mid-await zero new decision, terms drift blocked, stale-fence handle cannot assert/renew/settle, review commit rolls back after revoke with decision legitimately committed, strategy revision never lands on authority loss, deterministic checkpoint guarded, renew cannot extend past deadline, post-deadline settle/assert blocked, two-SQLite-connection fencing, manual regression. No merge, no deploy, driver stays opt-in OFF.
